by
  have g4 : ∀ v : NNReal, ∫ y, y ^ 4 ∂(ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v) = 3 * (v : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet (fun x : ℝ => x) (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v)) := by
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet_fun_id_gaussianReal]; simp
    have h2 : iteratedDeriv 4 (ProbabilityTheory.mgf (fun x : ℝ => x) (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v)) 0 = ∫ y, y ^ 4 ∂(ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v) := ProbabilityTheory.iteratedDeriv_mgf_zero h0 4
    rw [← h2, ProbabilityTheory.mgf_fun_id_gaussianReal]
    set a : ℝ := (v : ℝ) with ha
    have d0 : (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (0 * t + a * t ^ 2 / 2)) = fun t => Real.exp (a * t ^ 2 / 2) := by
      funext t; simp
    rw [d0]
    have hE : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (a * t ^ 2 / 2)) (a * t * Real.exp (a * t ^ 2 / 2)) t := by
      intro t
      have h : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => a * t ^ 2 / 2) (a * t) t := by
        exact ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 t).const_mul a).div_const 2 |>.congr_deriv (by norm_num; ring)
      exact h.exp.congr_deriv (by ring)
    have poly : ∀ (p p' : ℝ → ℝ) , (∀ t, HasDerivAt p (p' t) t) → ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun t => p t * Real.exp (a * t ^ 2 / 2)) ((p' t + p t * (a * t)) * Real.exp (a * t ^ 2 / 2)) t := by
      intro p p' hp t
      exact ((hp t).mul (hE t)).congr_deriv (by ring)
    have D1 : deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (a * t ^ 2 / 2)) = fun t => (a * t) * Real.exp (a * t ^ 2 / 2) := funext fun t => (hE t).deriv
    have hp1 : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => a * t) a t := fun t => by simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul a
    have D2 : deriv (fun t : ℝ => (a * t) * Real.exp (a * t ^ 2 / 2)) = fun t => (a + a ^ 2 * t ^ 2) * Real.exp (a * t ^ 2 / 2) := by
      funext t
      rw [(poly _ _ hp1 t).deriv]; ring
    have hp2 : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => a + a ^ 2 * t ^ 2) (2 * a ^ 2 * t) t := fun t => by
      exact (((hasDerivAt_pow 2 t).const_mul (a ^ 2)).const_add a).congr_deriv (by norm_num; ring)
    have D3 : deriv (fun t : ℝ => (a + a ^ 2 * t ^ 2) * Real.exp (a * t ^ 2 / 2)) = fun t => (3 * a ^ 2 * t + a ^ 3 * t ^ 3) * Real.exp (a * t ^ 2 / 2) := by
      funext t
      rw [(poly _ _ hp2 t).deriv]; ring
    have hp3 : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 3 * a ^ 2 * t + a ^ 3 * t ^ 3) (3 * a ^ 2 + 3 * a ^ 3 * t ^ 2) t := fun t => by
      exact (((hasDerivAt_id' t).const_mul (3 * a ^ 2)).add ((hasDerivAt_pow 3 t).const_mul (a ^ 3))).congr_deriv (by norm_num; ring)
    have D4 : deriv (fun t : ℝ => (3 * a ^ 2 * t + a ^ 3 * t ^ 3) * Real.exp (a * t ^ 2 / 2)) 0 = 3 * a ^ 2 := by
      rw [(poly _ _ hp3 0).deriv]; simp
    simp only [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_zero]
    rw [D1, D2, D3, D4]
  intro Ω _ P B s t h hm
  have hlaw := (h.hasLaw_sub s t).map_eq
  have hmd : Measurable (B s - B t) := (hm s).sub (hm t)
  have hnd : ((nndist s.1 t.1 : NNReal) : ℝ) = |(s : ℝ) - (t : ℝ)| := by
    rw [coe_nndist, Real.dist_eq]; rfl
  have e2 : ∫ ω, (B s ω - B t ω) ^ 2 ∂P = ∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂(P.map (B s - B t)) := (MeasureTheory.integral_map (f := fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) hmd.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)).symm
  have e4 : ∫ ω, (B s ω - B t ω) ^ 4 ∂P = ∫ y, y ^ 4 ∂(P.map (B s - B t)) := (MeasureTheory.integral_map (f := fun y : ℝ => y ^ 4) hmd.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)).symm
  constructor
  · rw [e2, hlaw, ← hnd]
    have hv := ProbabilityTheory.variance_fun_id_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := nndist s.1 t.1)
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.variance_of_integral_eq_zero (by fun_prop) (by simp)] at hv
    simpa using hv
  · rw [e4, hlaw, g4, hnd, sq_abs]
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (B : NNReal → Ω → ℝ) (s t : NNReal), ProbabilityTheory.IsPreBrownianReal B P → (∀ r, Measurable (B r)) → ∫ ω, (B s ω - B t ω) ^ 2 ∂P = |(s : ℝ) - (t : ℝ)| ∧ ∫ ω, (B s ω - B t ω) ^ 4 ∂P = 3 * ((s : ℝ) - (t : ℝ)) ^ 2
